    SELECT p."Id", p."Name", p."Stock", p."Price", p."CreatedDate", p."ModifiedDate"
    FROM "Products" AS p
    LIMIT @p OFFSET @p
) AS p1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT f0."Id", f0."CreatedDate", f0."Discriminator", f0."FileName", f0."Path", f0."Storage", f0."Showcase", p0."ProductImageFilesId", p0."ProductsId"
    FROM "ProductProductImageFile" AS p0
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedDate", f."Discriminator", f."FileName", f."Path", f."Storage", f."Showcase"
        FROM "Files" AS f
        WHERE f."Discriminator" = 'ProductImageFile'
    ) AS f0 ON p0."ProductImageFilesId" = f0."Id"
) AS s ON p1."Id" = s."ProductsId"
ORDER BY p1."Id", s."ProductImageFilesId", s."ProductsId"

) AS p1
LEFT JOIN (

    SELECT f0."Id", f0."CreatedDate", f0."Discriminator", f0."FileName", f0."Path", f0."Storage", f0."Showcase", p0."ProductImageFilesId", p0."ProductsId"
    FROM "ProductProductImageFile" AS p0
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedDate", f."Discriminator", f."FileName", f."Path", f."Storage", f."Showcase"
        FROM "Files" AS f
        WHERE f."Discriminator" = 'ProductImageFile'
    ) AS f0 ON p0."ProductImageFilesId" = f0."Id"
) AS s ON p1."Id" = s."ProductsId"
ORDER BY p1."Id", s."ProductImageFilesId", s."ProductsId"

SELECT p1."Id", p1."Name", p1."Stock", p1."Price", p1."CreatedDate", p1."ModifiedDate", s."Id", s."CreatedDate", s."Discriminator", s."FileName", s."Path", s."Storage", s."Showcase", s."ProductImageFilesId", s."ProductsId"
FROM (
    SELECT p."Id", p."Name", p."Stock", p."Price", p."CreatedDate", p."ModifiedDate"
    FROM "Products" AS p
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS p1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT f0."Id", f0."CreatedDate", f0."Discriminator", f0."FileName", f0."Path", f0."Storage", f0."Showcase", p0."ProductImageFilesId", p0."ProductsId"
    FROM "ProductProductImageFile" AS p0

        SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedDate", f."Discriminator", f."FileName", f."Path", f."Storage", f."Showcase"
